subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Seasonal Decomposition
description: Learn Seasonal Decomposition in one minute.

hook.text: Ice cream sales spike every June and crash every December. Ignoring seasonality makes forecasts useless.

buildup.text: Seasonal decomposition breaks demand into three parts: trend, seasonality, and random noise.

discovery.text: Isolating each component lets planners forecast the trend and overlay the seasonal pattern accurately.

twist.text: Seasonality can shift. Climate change, cultural shifts, and new products can alter patterns year over year.

climax.text: Retailers using seasonal models reduce forecast error by 20–30% compared to non-seasonal methods.

punchline.text: Demand has rhythms. Learn them and plan with them.
